caption: The drawing shows two red tassels, positioned vertically side by side, with long, flat red bands at the top and intricately woven knots just below. The bands and knots transition into tightly gathered bases from which several strands or cords hang down, forming the fringes of the tassels. The tassels are detailed with varying shades of red to depict texture and depth. To the right of the main tassels, there is a faint pencil sketch of a similar tassel design, showing the outline of the band, knot, and fringe. The drawing is centered on an off-white or beige background, and the artist's name, "Gladys C Parker," is written near the bottom right.
title: Civil War Sash
